{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nazay''' were an [[Alwari]] clan that lived in the [[Delgerhan]] province, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. They were known for the fine craftsmanship of their ornately-carved, high-backed seats that were used in sacred rituals by the ancient Alwari.<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
